summary: To trust a hub CA certificate, add rootCA.crt via additional_build_files and in prepend_base COPY it to the ca-trust anchors and RUN update-ca-trust; doing it in base makes it apply to all stages and the final image.
questions: How do I update the automation hub CA certificate in an execution environment?
Execution environment build fails with SSL error to automation hub
Why customize the CA in prepend_base?
